title: Dimethyl sulfide found on exoplanets as a sign of life elsewhere

tellings.quote: 120 uh light years away from us like we we found some dimethyl sulfide the dimethyl dulfide

plain: A guest named Chris Gilbert, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that scientists have found a chemical called dimethyl sulfide on exoplanets, which are planets circling other stars, about 120 light years away or more. He tells it as a possible sign of life elsewhere, since if the finding holds, it would hint that living things exist beyond Earth.
